card.name: The word so after sentence-initial And
card.fires_on: Mainly the word "so" right after a sentence-opening "And", as in "And so on" or "And so the struggle is on". Weaker on a few verbs like "possess" and "housed", and on "bruises" after heel.

modes.label: And so
modes.description: "so" directly after a sentence-initial "And", starting a continuation or closing phrase.
modes.example: And<< so>> forth. The Purposes of this Course

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Verbs such as possess or housed, and the noun bruises after heel.
modes.example: Athletes engaged in jumping events are at risk for developing heel<< bruises>>.
